title: A calculated table holds what was computed at refresh, when no role applies
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "Total", MAX ( GrandTotalSales[Grand Total Sales] ) )

source.quote: The calculated table is computed during the data refresh, when security is not active yet.
source.supports: GrandTotalSales = ROW ( "Grand Total Sales", [Sales Amount] ) holds the total of all sales

derivation: GrandTotalSales was computed over all five sales: 210. The role doesn't change it (it filters Customer, which GrandTotalSales isn't related to).
